role: adaptation-required queue from sensitive already-read notes
policy: Each row has a read note proving owned sources still lack the upstream fix. Rows stay missing from the final disposition ledger until an adaptation (or an evidence-backed not-applicable/inherited/already-adapted decision) lands. Not unread binge; not G11.

items.subject: fix(material/table): use ResizeObserver to react to size changes (#28783)
items.evidence: The patch realigns the paginated tab header from a shared resize observer and afterNextRender. The owned header still uses the viewport ruler and NgZone.onStable. Those hooks were not added.
items.note: Read note shows owned sources still lack the upstream fix. Closing would require product adaptation and regression coverage; left missing from final ledger until that work lands.

items.note: Read note shows owned sources still lack the upstream fix. Closing would require product adaptation and regression coverage; left missing from final ledger until that work lands.
